t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different Gnomes lead to different baskets. For example, Red, Pink, Purple and Brown Gnomes will provide a Red Basket. In order to maximise points, aim for the Red Basket in succession until it provides 0 mushrooms, and then aim for the Yellow basket until the same occurs. Then rinse and repeat.

vb_textbox.text: Throughout the game you will be given the option between two different coloured GNOMES. These GNOMES lead to BASKETS which mushrooms are then gathered from. Within the game, the GNOMES that will lead to the RED BASKET are RED, PINK, PURPLE, and BROWN. On the other hand, the GNOMES that lead to the YELLOW BASKET are YELLOW, ORANGE, BLUE, and GREEN. The best strategy to earn the most points in this game is to switch between the two coloured BASKETS. For example, begin the game aiming only to get the RED BASKET. Then, keep aiming for this BASKET until it yields 1 or 0 Mushrooms, and then switch to the YELLOW BASKET until it also yields 1 or 0 Mushrooms. Continue to utilise this strategy throughout the game.
